sources.title: Job sources
sources.menuBody: Add companies by name, website, or email so their jobs reach your matches
sources.body: Type a company's name, its website or careers page, a job board link, or a work email at the company. CareerPilot finds the company's jobs, sorts them into on-site, hybrid, and remote, matches them to your profile, and prepares applications like any other job. An administrator reviews each new company before sharing it with everyone.

welcome.eyebrow: For job seekers and students, at home and abroad
welcome.body: CareerPilot finds jobs and master's or PhD places that fit you, explains every match, shows the skills you're missing, and applies only the way you allow.

preview.label: A preview of the Today screen with matched jobs
preview.heading: Today

reasons.title: Every match explained
reasons.body: See why a job fits, what's required, and which requirements you meet before you spend a minute on it.

skills.title: Skills to add, before you apply
skills.body: Each job shows up to three skills it asks for that your profile doesn't list, so you can add them or learn them first.

companies.title: Follow any company
companies.body: Type a company's name, website, or work email. CareerPilot finds its jobs and sorts them into on-site, hybrid, and remote.

focus.title: Focused, never flooded
focus.body: Your country's on-site jobs come first, at most three per company, and nothing you applied to in the last 15 days comes back.

control.title: Applies your way
control.body: Approve each application, or let rules apply for you within your submission time. Pause everything with one tap.

proof.title: A record you can trust
proof.body: Every circular is archived and every application keeps its timeline, emails, and proof, even if the posting disappears.

profile.title: Build your profile once
profile.body: Experience, skills, documents, and answers you can reuse.

tracks.title: Choose your tracks
tracks.body: Home on-site, remote, international with sponsorship, or study abroad.

review.title: Review your matches
review.body: Reasons, requirements, and skills to add for every job.

apply.title: Approve and relax
apply.body: CareerPilot completes the application and keeps the proof.

welcome.promiseBody: Applying for jobs is personal. These rules hold for every user and every application.
